title: ADR 0006 thread merge column (deferred capability scaffold)
body_md: ADR 0006 'Out of scope' lists cross-thread merge: 'Add a merged_into column to thread_subscriptions if a real use case appears.' Scaffold the column as nullable + a `ux thread-merge <src> <dest>` verb that writes the column. Pure migration + CLI — no UI fanout yet.
acceptance_md: bun test bin/arc-ux.test.ts -t 'thread-merge'; merged_into column present + indexed; verb writes correctly.
evidence_md: ADR 0006 deferred scaffold: migration 012 thread_subscriptions + arc-ux thread-merge verb + tests (13/13 pass); commit 0dfcb46; PR #26
